game: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas - The Definitive Edition
platform: Nintendo Switch 2 (Switch version via backward compatibility; no native Switch 2 edition found, medium/low)
entryGate: Switch/Switch 2 have no native achievement system (confirmed by scouts). No source shows Social Club accomplishments on Switch (low). Gate passes.

nativeList.summary: PS4/PS5 list, 35 trophies (1P/5G/8S/21B, totals high). Xbox: same 34 minus Platinum, 1000G. 13 extra entries (Sticky Fingers, 81 Years Too Late, Get a Pump, ...) are Social Club accomplishments.

entries.name: With Extra Dip
entries.description: Buy 8 meals from Cluckin' Bell throughout the game.

entries.name: Hoopin' it Up
entries.description: Score at least 30 points in the basketball mini-game.

entries.name: Pay 'n' Spray
entries.description: Use a Pay 'n' Spray with a wanted level.

entries.name: Bike or Biker
entries.description: Complete either the BMX or NRG challenge.

entries.name: Who Needs Directions?
entries.description: Find Mike Toreno without any of the referenced locations during Mike Toreno.

entries.name: Liberty City State of Mind
entries.description: Complete the Saint Mark's Bistro mission.

entries.name: They Can't Stop All of Us
entries.description: Sneak into the underground base without setting off the alarm above ground during Black Project.

entries.name: Savior
entries.note: PowerPyx spells it 'Saviour'; GTABase/GTA Wiki 'Savior'. Spelling unresolved.

entries.name: Yes I Speak English
entries.description: Complete 50 fares in the Taxi Driver side mission (PowerPyx wording: Reach 50 fares in Taxi Mode).

entries.name: Lucky Spinner
entries.description: Win at least $1,000 in a single spin of the Wheel of Fortune.

entries.name: All Dressed Up for San Fierro
Not a Player
entries.description: Go on at least one date with every potential girlfriend.

entries.name: What are the Odds
entries.description: Win a race in Inside Track betting.

entries.name: Double or Nothin'
entries.description: Put all your money or the maximum bet on red or black and win.

entries.name: Assassin
entries.description: Stealth kill all enemies in the mission Madd Dogg's Rhymes.

entries.name: Today Was a Good Day
entries.description: Go 24 hours (in game) without breaking the law, being wanted, killing or harming anyone.

entries.name: Ain't Nothing But a G Thing

entries.name: ...Here we go again

switchDifferences: Launch performance poor; later patches (incl. Nov 2024 Classic Lighting update) reached Switch.
No content differences vs PS/Xbox found.
definitiveEditionChanges: Mid-mission checkpoints and instant retry added.
Cheats disable trophies on PS/Xbox (irrelevant on Switch).
conflicts: Unique stunt jumps required for 100%: no (PowerPyx, Sportskeeda) vs yes (gtaintel).
gaps: Stats screen collectible counters (tags/snapshots/horseshoes/oysters/jumps), turf count, girlfriend %, unconfirmed in DE.
Mission replay: scout C says missions cannot be replayed (single source).

campaign.name: Los Santos (opening act)
campaign.detail: gta.wiki lists 29 entries from In the Beginning to The Green Sabre: In the Beginning, Big Smoke, Sweet & Kendl, Ryder, Tagging Up Turf, Cleaning the Hood, Drive-Thru, Nines and AK's, Drive-By, Sweet's Girl, Cesar Vialpando, OG Loc, Running Dog, Wrong Side of the Tracks, Just Business, Home Invasion, Catalyst, Robbing Uncle Sam, High Stakes Low-Rider, Life's a Beach, Madd Dogg's Rhymes, Management Issues, House Party, Burning Desire, Gray Imports, Doberman, Los Sepulcros, Reuniting the Families, The Green Sabre. Ends with CJ leaving LS.

campaign.name: Countryside / Badlands (Red County, Flint County, Whetstone)
campaign.detail: gta.wiki lists 14: Badlands, First Date, Tanker Commander, Body Harvest, King in Exile, First Base, Local Liquor Store, Gone Courting, Against All Odds, Made in Heaven, Small Town Bank, Wu Zi Mu, Farewell My Love..., Are You Going to San Fierro? Several (Catalina, The Truth, Woozie) are interleaved with the SF/Desert arcs, so the arc order is not strictly separate. The gta.wiki list does not mark which are optional.

campaign.name: San Fierro
campaign.detail: gta.wiki lists 26: Wear Flowers in Your Hair, 555 We Tip, Deconstruction, Air Raid, Supply Lines..., New Model Army, Back to School (Driving School), Photo Opportunity, Jizzy, T-Bone Mendez, Mike Toreno, Mountain Cloud Boys, Ran Fa Li, Lure, Amphibious Assault, The Da Nang Thang, Outrider, Snail Trail, Ice Cold Killa, Pier 69, Toreno's Last Flight, Yay Ka-Boom-Boom, Zeroing In, Test Drive, Customs Fast Track, Puncture Wounds. Plot: CJ wins a garage (Doherty), tracks Loco Syndicate leader Mike Toreno, who is a government agent. NOTE: Yay Ka-Boom-Boom is listed by gta.wiki under San Fierro; Wikipedia/PowerPyx tie it to the Triad/Wu Zi Mu line and it unlocks Las Venturas and the Freight Train tasks.

campaign.name: Desert (Tierra Robada, Bone County)
campaign.detail: gta.wiki lists 9: Monster, Highjack, Interdiction, Verdant Meadows, Learning to Fly, N.O.E., Stowaway, Black Project, Green Goo. Mike Toreno line. Learning to Fly requires bronze in all flight school lessons (per PowerPyx).

campaign.name: Las Venturas
campaign.detail: gta.wiki lists 18: Fender Ketchup, Explosive Situation, You've Had Your Chips, Don Peyote, Architectural Espionage, Key to Her Heart, Dam and Blast, Cop Wheels, Up Up and Away!, Intensive Care, The Meat Business, Fish in a Barrel, Madd Dogg, Freefall, Misappropriation, High Noon, Saint Mark's Bistro, Breaking the Bank at Caligula's. CJ becomes casino co-owner, plans robbery of Mafia-run casino (heist = Architectural Espionage through Breaking the Bank at Caligula's), saves Madd Dogg from suicide (mission Madd Dogg) and becomes his manager. Saint Mark's Bistro is the Liberty City-themed mafia mission (has an achievement).

campaign.name: Return to Los Santos
campaign.detail: gta.wiki lists 9: A Home in the Hills, Vertical Bird, Home Coming, Cut Throat Business, Beat Down on B Dup, Grove 4 Life, Riot, Los Desperados, End of the Line. Tenpenny acquittal triggers citywide riot.

campaign.name: End of the Line (final mission)
campaign.detail: CJ finds Big Smoke's hideout (Smoke's Crack Palace) and kills him. Tenpenny arrives, takes the money, escapes via explosion, flees in a fire truck chased by CJ and Sweet, crashes off a bridge above Grove Street and dies; riot ends. Credits follow (achievement 'Time to Kill' for watching them is Social Club/PC-type).
campaign.trackable: Mission completion counted in stats/percentage; achievement 'The End of the Line' exists on DE (Xbox/PS/PC list).

campaign.name: Story-related achievements with mission-specific conditions (DE list)
campaign.detail: Getting Started (complete Big Smoke); Assassin (stealth-kill every enemy in Madd Dogg's Rhymes); All Dressed Up for San Fierro (complete The Green Sabre); Who Needs Directions? (find Toreno in the Mike Toreno mission without relying on the referenced locations); What happens in Las Venturas... (complete Yay Ka-Boom-Boom); They Can't Stop All of Us (Black Project: reach the underground base without triggering the above-ground alarm); Liberty City State of Mind (complete Saint Mark's Bistro); The End of the Line (complete End of the Line). Green Goo has no listed dedicated achievement.
campaign.missable: Mission-specific ones (Assassin, Who Needs Directions?, They Can't Stop All of Us) must be done on the first attempt or retried via Replay Mission; replay availability not confirmed.

campaign.name: Story mission count
campaign.detail: SOURCES DISAGREE. PowerPyx (DE 100% guide): 98 story missions required + 26 asset missions. gta.wiki: stated total 101 but its own section counts sum to 105 (29+14+26+9+18+9), likely including Driving School/Pier 69/etc. Sportskeeda: 101 incl. opening, or 100; one source 90 main missions. Do NOT use a single number in a trophy without in-game confirmation.

campaign.name: 100% completion requirements (non-story)
campaign.detail: PowerPyx: 26 asset missions (Courier 3, Trucking 8, Quarry 7, Zero RC 3, Wang Cars 4, Valet 1); vehicle challenges 3 (BMX, NRG-500, Chiliad); vehicle missions 6 (Firefighter, Paramedic, Vigilante, Pimping, Freight Train, Taxi 50 fares); race tournaments (intro says 19, race section says 16 - inconsistent); 6 checkpoint races; 4 stadium events; 33 vehicle school lessons; 100 tags; 50 snapshots; 50 horseshoes; 50 oysters; 3 export lists of 10 cars; 4 shooting range challenges; 24 properties + 5 hotel suites; 3 gyms. Not required: 70 unique jumps, girlfriends, turf takeover. Guide says nothing for 100% is missable.
campaign.trackable: Overall percent in Stats menu (user reports).

campaign.name: Remastered / ...Here we go again
campaign.detail: Remastered: reach 100% completion (100G Gold). ...Here we go again: start a new game after reaching 100% on a save.

campaign.name: Ain't Nothing But a G Thing
campaign.detail: Own all gang turfs and properties and have $1,000,000 (Gold). Late-game; turf war is not needed for percentage but needed for this achievement.

sideContent.name: Gang Tags (graffiti)
sideContent.detail: 100, all in Los Santos. Required for 100%. Reward: weapons at Grove Street (Tec-9, AK-47, sawn-off, Molotovs per PowerPyx).
sideContent.trackable: Not confirmed which Stats screen shows a tag count.

sideContent.name: Snapshots
sideContent.detail: 50, San Fierro. Required for 100%. Only the floating icon needs photographing. Reward: weapons plus $100,000 (PowerPyx).

sideContent.name: Horseshoes
sideContent.detail: 50, Las Venturas. Required for 100%. Reward: weapons plus $100,000. One source says they max Luck, which is unverified.

sideContent.name: Oysters
sideContent.detail: 50, underwater across the map. Required for 100%. Reward: $100,000, lung capacity, sex appeal. Sources disagree on the perk wording.

sideContent.name: Unique Stunt Jumps
sideContent.detail: 70 total, $500 each. NOT required for 100% per PowerPyx and Sportskeeda. One weaker source (gtaintel) says required.

sideContent.name: Story and asset missions
sideContent.detail: 98 story missions. 26 asset missions: Courier 3, Trucking 8, Quarry 7, Zero RC 3 ($30,000), Wang Cars 4 ($50,000), Valet level 5 (must wear Valet outfit).

sideContent.name: Vehicle challenges
sideContent.detail: BMX: 19 checkpoints (cycling skill over 20%). NRG-500: 18 checkpoints. Chiliad Challenge: 3 routes, daytime 07:00-18:00, cycling over 40%.

sideContent.name: Vehicle missions
sideContent.detail: Firefighter, Paramedic, Vigilante: level 12 in one go. Pimping: level 10 in one go. Freight: level 2. Taxi: 50 fares total (not one go).

sideContent.name: Races and stadium events
sideContent.detail: Race tournaments: 1st in all 19 (LS 9, SF 6, LV 4; the PowerPyx page also says 16 once, inconsistent). Checkpoint races: 6 at LV airport. Stadium: 8-Track 1st (20% driving skill), Blood Bowl, Dirt Track 1st (Mon/Wed only), Kickstart 26+ points (not Mon/Wed).

sideContent.name: Vehicle schools
sideContent.detail: Bronze minimum counts: Driving 12, Boat 5, Bike 6, Flying 10 (33 lessons). Silver/gold not required, only unlock vehicles. Trophy-style achievement 'School's Out' = fully complete one school.

sideContent.name: Misc 100% items
sideContent.detail: Export/Import: 3 lists of 10 cars (up to $1,444,000). Shooting range: 4 challenges in one session. Properties: 24 plus 5 hotel suites = 29, $879,000. Gyms: all 3 moves from each of 3 trainers (needs 35%+ muscle).

sideContent.name: Not required for 100%
sideContent.detail: 70 unique jumps, girlfriends at 100%, taking all gang turfs, silver/gold school medals. Also not mentioned as required: burglary, casino, Chiliad beyond routes, Bigfoot.

sideContent.name: 100% completion rewards
sideContent.detail: $1,000,000, ammo refill, double vehicle strength (per PowerPyx), Hydra on Sweet's roof, Rhino under Grove Street bridge, plus 'Remastered' achievement/trophy (100 pts in GTABase list).

sideContent.name: Existing DE achievement list (side-content related)
sideContent.detail: Remastered; ...Here we go again (new game after 100%); A Legitimate Business (3 export lists); School's Out; What the City Needs / Savior / Rescue a Kitten Too? (12 levels); Yes I Speak English (50 taxi fares); Bike or Biker (BMX or NRG); Not a Player (date every potential girlfriend); Ain't Nothing But a G Thing (own all turfs + properties + $1,000,000); Sticky Fingers ($10,000 burglary); Lucky Spinner; What are the Odds (Inside Track); Double or Nothin'; Today Was a Good Day; 81 Years Too Late (24h on foot hunting Bigfoot); Freight Date; Get a Pump; Beat the Cock; Metrosexual ($6,969); Represent; High As a Kite; Lots of Guns; Swiss Army Strife; Chick Magnet; Smooth Moves; The American Dream; I'll Have Two Number 9s; With Extra Dip. Useful for avoiding duplicates. No collectible-count achievement was listed.

systems.name: Respect
systems.detail: Raised by missions and gang territory wins; caps number of recruitable homies (up to 7). Maxing it grants the 'Original Gangster' achievement/trophy.
systems.trackable: Stats menu (progress bar per stat, per one weaker source). Max-respect trophy is listed as 'Original Gangster'.

systems.name: Sex Appeal
systems.detail: Raised by clothes, haircuts, tattoos, and the car CJ arrives in (lowriders/sports cars best). Collecting all 50 Oysters maxes it. 'Chick Magnet' = max sex appeal. One source says 100% muscle hurts sex appeal; another says muscle/fat do not affect it (sources conflict).

systems.name: Fat
systems.detail: Raised by eating at fast food (approx light 0, low ~1%, medium ~2%, high ~3.5%); lowered by running/gym machines. 'I'll Have Two Number 9s' = reach max fat via large meals.

systems.name: Muscle
systems.detail: Gyms and running/swimming/cycling. Needs >=35% for gym trainers to fight you. Each gym teaches 3 fighting moves. 'Get a Pump' = one barbell curl or bench press at any gym. Muscle burns off if fat is zero and CJ stops eating.
systems.trackable: Stats screen; gym moves learned are NOT shown in stats menu (per a PowerPyx comment).

systems.name: Stamina and Lung Capacity
systems.detail: Stamina by swimming/running/cycling/gym; lung capacity by underwater swimming. Collecting all 50 Oysters maxes lung capacity. Burglar side mission giving infinite stamina is single-source claim.

systems.name: Weapon skills
systems.detail: 'Swiss Army Strife' requires maxing all 10 eligible weapon skills to Hitman (PowerPyx); gtabase says 'all weapon skills'. Each Ammu-Nation shooting challenge gives 200 skill in its weapon.

systems.name: Vehicle skills (driving, bike, cycling, flying, boat) and schools
systems.detail: Cycling skill >20% for BMX challenge (60%+ recommended, 'Bike or Biker'), >40% for Chiliad Challenge. Driving skill >=20% for 8-Track. 100% requires bronze in Driving School (12 lessons), Boat School (5), Bike School (6), Flying School (10; bronze done during 'Learning to Fly').
systems.trackable: Stats screen for skill percentages; school medals appear in school menus.

systems.name: Collectibles (required for 100%)
systems.detail: 100 Gang Tags (Los Santos), 50 Snapshots (San Fierro), 50 Horseshoes (Las Venturas), 50 Oysters (underwater). Rewards: tags unlock weapons at Johnson House; snapshots weapons at Doherty Garage + $100,000; horseshoes weapons at Four Dragons Casino + $100,000; oysters $100,000 + max lung + girlfriends date regardless of appearance. Note: 70 Unique Jumps are NOT required for 100%.
systems.trackable: Stats screen collectible counters (assumed from original; DE-specific display not confirmed).

systems.name: 100% completion ('Remastered')
systems.detail: Requires 98 Story Missions and 26 Asset Missions plus other items. Reward: $1,000,000, full ammo, Hydra at Sweet's house, Rhino under Grove Street bridge, and the 'Remastered' trophy. Users report getting stuck at 99.47% (unbought Palomino Creek property, unfinished Chiliad Challenge race, Blood Bowl, Millie heist) - unverified.
systems.trackable: Stats menu shows completion percentage (implied by user reports of 99.47%).

systems.name: Who Needs Directions? (Mike Toreno mission)
systems.detail: Drive to Easter Basin Airport in San Fierro ignoring hints. Missable per PowerPyx. Missions cannot be replayed (GamerGuides).

systems.name: They Can't Stop All of Us (Black Project mission)
systems.detail: Infiltrate underground base without triggering the above-ground alarm; pops after mission end. Missable.

systems.name: Assassin (Madd Dogg's Rhymes mission)
systems.detail: Stealth-kill every guard in the mansion section unseen; pops on leaving mansion. Missable.

systems.name: Gang territories lost after leaving Los Santos
systems.detail: All held turfs are lost when first leaving Los Santos; after 'Home Coming' they must be recaptured. 53 turfs total. 'Ain't Nothing But a G Thing' requires all turfs, all properties, and $1,000,000. Capturing turfs early is wasted effort. Turfs are NOT required for 100% completion.
systems.trackable: Map shows turf ownership; exact turf counter unconfirmed.

systems.name: Girlfriends / 'Not a Player'
systems.detail: 6 potential girlfriends per PowerPyx. Trophy pops when the 6th date starts. Dating Katie Zhan lets you keep weapons on death. Girlfriend relationships to 100% not required for 100% completion.
systems.trackable: Girlfriend percentages in Stats screen (original game feature; DE not confirmed).

systems.name: Gambling achievements
systems.detail: Lucky Spinner: win $1,000+ on one Wheel of Fortune spin (max bet $10). What are the Odds: win one Inside Track race (save before betting). Double or Nothin': bet table max on red/black at roulette until win. All save-scumming friendly.
systems.trackable: Gambling skill listed in stats (gtaintel); no per-bet counter confirmed.

systems.name: Today Was a Good Day
systems.detail: Go 24 in-game hours without breaking the law, being wanted, or harming anyone.

systems.name: 48 achievements (full list)
systems.detail: Per gta.wiki: Getting Started, With Extra Dip, The End of the Line, Hoopin' it Up, A Legitimate Business, I'll Have Two Number 9s, The American Dream, Pay 'n' Spray, Bike or Biker, Who Needs Directions?, Liberty City State of Mind, Swiss Army Strife, School's Out, Horror of the Santa Maria, They Can't Stop All of Us, Smooth Moves, What the City Needs, Savior, Rescue a Kitten Too?, Yes I Speak English, Lucky Spinner, What happens in Las Venturas..., All Dressed Up for San Fierro, Not a Player, What are the Odds, Double or Nothin', Assassin, Original Gangster, Today Was a Good Day, Public Enemy No. 1, Chick Magnet, Ain't Nothing But a G Thing, Remastered, ...Here we go again, I Ain't No Buster, Sticky Fingers, 81 Years Too Late, Get a Pump, Beat the Cock, Metrosexual, Where'd He Go?, High As a Kite, Represent, Assert Yourself Next Time, Serial Offender, Freight Date, Time to Kill, Lots of Guns. versionNotes.note: Achievement list differs per platform: Xbox/PlayStation/PC DE have 34-35 achievements/trophies (1 Platinum 'I Ain't No Buster'), and PC adds 13 Rockstar Social Club-only accomplishments (48 total per gta.wiki). Switch has no in-system achievements/trophies as far as searched; not explicitly confirmed. A Switch 2 upgrade/edition was NOT found in search.
DE added mission-specific achievement conditions (stealth kills, alarm avoidance, finding Toreno) not in the 2004 original.
Switch version launched 11 Nov 2021 (Trilogy), with gyro aiming and touchscreen support.

Switch has no native trophy system; the lists above are Xbox/PlayStation/Social Club style. Cheats disable achievements/trophies on PS/Xbox/PC. Whether the Switch version has any in-game achievement tracking was NOT confirmed.
Switch version has gyro aiming and touch controls; heavier performance/visual downgrade than PS4. Reader comment mentions a Switch-specific gym-training bug (unverified).
Latest Switch patch found is 1.0.7 (Perfectly Nintendo); notes cover stability and mission fixes only.

No native Nintendo Switch achievement system exists, and no source found says the Switch version has any achievements/trophies/Social Club accomplishments. Rockstar's 2021 release said updated Achievements/Trophies exist for the trilogy and that PC gets additional Social Club accomplishments; Switch version feature list names only gyro aiming and touch screen. Treat Switch having ZERO in-game achievements as likely but UNCONFIRMED.

No Switch 2 Edition of the GTA Trilogy found as of Oct 2026. Switch 2 runs the original Switch release via backward compatibility (Sportskeeda: Rockstar titles incl. the Trilogy work; claims steadier 30fps, faster loading, 720p - single secondary source). Red Dead Redemption got a dedicated Switch 2 version in Dec 2025 but not the Trilogy. Nintendo's own eShop page lists no Switch 2 Edition.

Switch-specific: gyro aiming and touch screen camera/menu support. Launch Switch version had very poor performance (VGC 2/5, ~20fps dips); Nintendo Life later checked patch improvements (conclusion not read).
Local 2-player co-op from the original console versions was removed in the DE (Den of Geek, Cheat Code Central, Sportskeeda).

Songs cut from DE radio: counts disagree - 17 (Nintendo Wire/GTAIntel) vs 21 (Sportskeeda). Cuts largely predate the DE (rights lapsed in earlier releases). Cut music reportedly remained on disk in PC files (unverified).

Interiors: original reportedly 150+ hidden interiors vs ~33 in DE (single source, GTAIntel, suspect). Some cheats dropped. Some haircut options missing. Analog steering removed, fewer civilians/vehicles. Weapons are kept after death. Mid-mission checkpoint restart added.
PowerPyx recommends Performance mode over Fidelity because some cutscenes may crash in Fidelity (PS-focused; Switch has no such modes presumably).

Xbox list is the same 34 achievements as PS minus the Platinum (no platinum on Xbox). Xbox gamerscore per GTABase/GTA Wiki: 34 entries totalling 1000 (GTABase lists values: 10,5,25,15,40,25,15,15,20,40,25,50,40,5,40,10,40,45,40,45,10,25,25,25,10,25,25,35,45,25,25,50,100,25). Total 35 on PS, 34 on Xbox.

Social Club has 13 additional 'accomplishments' (Sticky Fingers, 81 Years Too Late, Get a Pump, Beat the Cock, Metrosexual, Where'd He Go?, High As a Kite, Represent, Assert Yourself Next Time, Serial Offender, Freight Date, Time to Kill, Lots of Guns) that are NOT trophies/achievements. GTABase's '48' count includes them.
Per PowerPyx: no save transfer from original/other versions on PS4/PS5.
Switch/Switch 2 versions have no native trophies; PS list is the reference.
